title: Amid Chinese Pressure, Taiwan's President Cement Ties with Eswatini
description: Taiwan's President Lai Ching-te arrived in Eswatini, defying diplomatic challenges posed by Chinese pressure, to strengthen ties. The visit, initially delayed due to revoked flight permits, aims to deepen economic and cultural relations with its only African ally, amid China's ongoing efforts to isolate Taiwan diplomatically.
